action.instructions: Choose the best next action to win this rooftop fight. Avoid falling off and exploit opportunities to attack.

criteria.APPROACH_OPPONENT: Close the gap to a distant enemy when there is no immediate danger.
criteria.RETREAT_FROM_OPPONENT: Back away from a nearby enemy to create space while my attack recovers.
criteria.PUSH_OPPONENT: Attack an enemy within reach with a shove, especially during their recovery or near their edge.
criteria.GRAB_NEAREST_OBJECT: Pick up a nearby weapon when empty handed and the enemy is far away.
criteria.THROW_HELD_OBJECT_AT_OPPONENT: Attack by throwing my held weapon at the enemy through a clear lane.
criteria.DODGE_LEFT: Evade an incoming projectile or close enemy attack by dodging left.
criteria.DODGE_RIGHT: Evade an incoming projectile or close enemy attack by dodging right.
criteria.MOVE_TOWARD_SAFETY: Escape a dangerous edge or shrinking boundary by moving toward the center.
criteria.TAKE_COVER: Get behind solid cover against a distant enemy holding a throwable weapon.
criteria.JUMP: Jump over a low obstacle or low projectile.
